title: Ostad
desc: Sanjay and Mili, two college goers, fall in love with each other. Their fathers are business rivals and this creates various problems in their lives.

title: Bourani
desc: A manipulative woman schemes to control her brother's wealth by orchestrating a marriage, but her plans begin to unravel when unexpected love enters the picture.

title: Teen Murti
desc: Nabin, Nagen and Naren, three retired men, are the best of friends. Soon, they decide to revive an old tea shop and make some profits.

title: Mayer Adhikar
desc: Joy falls for Asha after she helps him recover from a mysterious accident.

title: Pita Maata Santan
desc: Shikha and Pradeep's marital bliss is shattered when he takes their daughter, Jaya, away. A few years later, fate brings them face to face when Jaya becomes employed in Shikha's company.
